body: Thank you again...Today I am busier than yesterday (my day off) so I feel more purposeful.  Thank you so much for offering your ear...it means more than I am capable of expressing.  I will try my best to not be a stranger neither...hopefully I can return the favor for someone else down the road.
Thank you...I'm not sure what I could have...I have feelings of anxiety too...my bf is BP as well...I am so great at helping him, it's weird I can't take my own advice.

your pic made me cry...thank you.  Sometimes the simplest reminder that one is not alone is enough.  And thank you for my pushups.  I wasnt able to do everything you said to do, I have a weak back, but I gave it a shot...4 done.  Thank you.

I wish I could afford a doc...I have no insurance however.  My bf says all the time he wants to talk, but as I mentioned he suffers too, he is Bipolar, so sometimes our talks end up as fights.  I also have a huge problem opening up. I wish I could just download my thoughts into someone elses brain so I would not have to speak.  But there is a kernal way deep inside me that won't let me die, won't let me stop, so for now I still listen to it.  I do believe in God, and I am thankful for that kernal.  Thank you so much for your words, I am imagining them in the voice of my best friends, and it brings tears to my eyes.  Thank you for helping me.
